questions.question: A GenAI system must generate text after querying multiple APIs. What layer coordinates this process?
questions.explanation: The orchestration layer coordinates interactions between models, APIs, tools, databases, and business workflows. It gathers information from multiple sources, manages execution flow, and prepares context before generation.

questions.question: Which of the following is a generative model trained with an adversarial (generator vs. discriminator) objective?
questions.explanation: GANs consist of two competing neural networks: a generator that creates samples and a discriminator that attempts to distinguish real data from generated data. This adversarial training process is the defining characteristic of GANs.

questions.question: Which of the following are typical characteristics of Small Language Models (SLMs)? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Fewer parameters than large frontier models
Suitability for resource-constrained or edge hardware
Faster inference and lower latency in many cases
Lower compute and memory needs for inference

questions.explanation: Small Language Models typically have fewer parameters, require less memory and compute, offer faster inference, and can often run on edge devices or resource-constrained hardware. These properties make them attractive for low-latency and cost-sensitive applications.
